in_marathi.name: Vimal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Pure, Free from defects
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vimal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vimal comes from the Sanskrit word ‘vimaltam’ which means ‘pure, free from defects, stainless, clear’. In Hindu mythology, Vimal is a name given to gods and goddesses who embody purity and virtue.

in_bengali.name: Vimal
